title: The sun on the sill
logline: The last day of January and sun on the sill for the first time since the Rain began: the four jars throwing four shadows, the bird gone from among them, the pup asleep in the strip of light. The Rain's end, drawn as shadows.

panels.composition: A garage window sill in low winter sun with four jars casting four long shadows across it, a small three-legged dog asleep in the strip of light on the floor below.
